description: This file defines the TenantDatabaseUpgradeService class, which handles automatic database schema upgrades for tenants in a Fineract application during startup. It manages upgrades for the tenant store database as well as individual tenant databases, utilizing Liquibase for schema migrations, and supports multi-threaded execution for tenant upgrades.

classes.name: TenantDatabaseUpgradeService
classes.description: A service responsible for upgrading tenant databases and the tenant store database upon application startup.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Initializes database upgrades after bean properties are set, skipping if in Liquibase only mode or if upgrades are disabled.

methods.name: upgradeTenantStore
methods.description: Performs database upgrade for the tenant store.

methods.name: logTenantStoreDetails
methods.description: Logs details of the tenant store configuration and credentials.

methods.name: upgradeIndividualTenants
methods.description: Orchestrates concurrent upgrading of all tenants' databases.

methods.name: createTenantUpgradeThreadPoolTaskExecutor
methods.description: Creates a thread pool executor for tenant upgrades.

methods.name: upgradeIndividualTenant
methods.description: Upgrades an individual tenant's database within a separate thread context.

methods.name: applyInitialLiquibase
methods.description: Applies initial Liquibase migration, syncing changelog if necessary.
